# Lake Washington School District

> Lake Washington School District (LWSD) provides comprehensive K-12 education services in the Puget Sound region with integrated technology platforms, parent engagement tools, and student support resources.

LWSD serves students across Washington state with a focus on academic achievement, STEM programs, and student well-being. The district uses Skyward for student information management, Microsoft 365 for digital learning, and multiple parent communication platforms to support families.

## Key Topics

- Skyward Family Access
- Skyward Student Portal
- Microsoft 365
- ClassLink Single Sign-On
- ParentSquare
- Password Reset & MFA
- Student Grades & Attendance
- Online Payments
- Technology Support
- Parent Portal Access
- Crisis Resources
- Student Information System
- Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
- Nondiscrimination Policy
- STEM Programs

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [Home - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org): Lake Washington School District homepage with news, achievements, and programs
- [Help - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help): Help center for student registration, transportation, and technology support
- [Contact Us - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/contact-us): Contact information and support resources for LWSD services
- [Crisis Resources - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/crisis-resources): Mental health crisis resources and emergency hotlines for students

## Parent Portal & Account Access

- [Guide to Parent Logins - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/guide-to-parent-logins): Guide for parents to access Skyward Family Access and related apps
- [Skyward Family Access Support - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/skyward-family-access): Parent guide to Skyward portal for grades, attendance, and student info
- [ParentSquare - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/parentsquare): ParentSquare setup and account activation guide for parent communications
- [Online Payment Support - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/online-payment-support): Support for online payments through Skyward and InTouchReceipting

## Student Access & Academic Tools

- [Skyward Student Access Support - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/skyward-student-access-support): Student guide to Skyward portal for grades, transcripts, and graduation plans
- [ClassLink - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/classlink): ClassLink setup guide for single sign-on and LaunchPad access
- [Student Password - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/student-password): Student password management and reset guide for Microsoft 365 accounts

## Authentication & Security

- [Password Registration and Recovery - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/password-registration-and-recovery): Password reset and multi-factor authentication guide for Microsoft 365

## Policies & Compliance

- [Annual Notifications - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/annual-notifications): Annual notifications covering nondiscrimination policy and student rights
- [Website Accessibility - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/website-accessibility): ADA compliance and WCAG standards with AudioEye accessibility features

## Optional

- [Directions to Administrative Offices - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/driving-directions-to-administrative-offices): Directions and address for L.E. Scarr Resource Center in Redmond
- [Website Feedback - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/website-feedback): Website feedback and issue reporting form for user support
- [Original Summons & Complaint Response - Lake Washington School District](https://www.lwsd.org/help/original-summons-complaint-response): Legal process service information and district policy documentation
